name: single_engine_change_vs_full_campaign
cost_basis: Per-component 60-minute mutation budget; sum of all 14 components = full campaign; 1 component = planner-selected for the canonical single-engine-change scenario (Scenario B). Cost basis matches the C42.25/C42.26 cost model.
notes: Avoided 13/14 = 92.86% of the full mutation cost without reducing certification confidence. The avoided work would have re-measured 13 components whose evidence remained valid under the C42.27 invalidation rules.
